name: iam-object-limit-auditor
description: Enumerates IAM roles and policies and flags every object approaching an IAM size or count limit - managed policies per role near the limit, trust policy near 2048 characters, managed policy near 6144, inline policy near 10240, and entity counts near account quotas - then produces a prioritized remediation plan (consolidate versus request increase) and pre-drafts the Service Quotas requests. Read-only. Recommends the AWS Documentation MCP for current IAM quota values as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on TUE at 15:00 UTC
